items.title: Stop the Ask IGNIS shared cache from serving one member's personalised reply to others
items.why: supabase/functions/ask-ignis/index.ts:507-508 keys the semantic cache on sha256(normalized question) only. Single-turn replies are generated with the member memory and profile block (:603-606) and written to that shared cache (:750), then served to any later asker of the same question (:511-528), including anonymous visitors. The key also ignores interview mode, plan tier and page context.
items.outcome: No visitor or member ever receives an answer generated from another member's data; cached answers match the asker's mode and tier.
items.recipe: Key the cache on sha256(mode | tier | contextHash | question); skip both read and write whenever memoryBlock or profileBlock is non-empty; purge the existing cache table once. Add a Deno unit test with two members proving no cross-hit.

premises.claim: Cache key is the normalized question only

L1.recipe: Skip cache when memory/profile present; purge table.

L2.recipe: Plus composite key and cross-member unit test.

L3.recipe: Plus a cache-hit audit field in the meter and a daily privacy probe.

evidence.interpretation: supabase/functions/ask-ignis/index.ts:507-508 keys the semantic cache on sha256(normalized question) only. Single-turn replies are generated with the member memory and profile block (:603-606) and written to that shared cache (:750), then served to any later asker of the same question (:511-528), including anonymous visitors. The key also ignores interview mode, plan tier and page context.
